title: 第209章 太凶猛了，这才是真男人！
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你想怎么补偿我？”李大壮明知故问。

曹萍见他没当场拒绝，觉得有戏，兴奋的身子都在颤抖，身前那两座饱满高耸，随之触动着李大壮结实的胸肌。

柔软和硬实的碰撞，最容易摩擦出激情的火花，俩人之间的氛围更加暧昧……

“李神医~你怎么故意逗人家呢~人家都这样了，当然是肉……”曹萍停顿了一下，红唇微动，贴在李大壮耳边，吹着香气把后那个字说了出来：“偿~~”

李大壮不拒绝，也不主动，任由曹萍在自己身上作乱！

他越是这样，曹萍越着急，柔弱无骨的玉手缓缓向下游走，红唇却贴上了李大壮的双唇！

李大壮自然不会将她推开，而是顺势品尝起来……

哪怕只是唇枪舌战，可曹萍却也彻底被征服了！

什么叫真男人？

李神医这样的才是真男人！

太凶猛了，唇枪舌战都能打的如此激烈！

以前和王强的时候，一点激情都没有，现在可真是太刺激了！

李大壮也不跟她客气，唇枪舌战的同时，手也没闲着，激荡起了一阵阵涟漪！

而且曹萍的身子和看起来一样，特别软，勾的李大壮一身火气！

曹萍也感受到了李大壮汹涌澎湃的热情，于是继续攻城略地，甚至想直击痛处！

却被李大壮抓住了手腕！

“李神医~干嘛拦着人家？”曹萍娇娇嗔的问。

“你可是有老公的人，这么做，不怕王强知道了收拾你？”

李大壮虽然火气很大，但他也真好奇，曹萍这会儿虽然骚浪的很，但他能看出来，这女人内在还是很保守的，跟王强这种半废不废的家伙结婚多年，都没出过轨，绝对称得上良家妇女！

那现在她怎么忽然跟自己放浪起来了？

李大壮忽然想到，撵王强走之前，他拉着曹萍嘀咕了半天，不会是他让曹萍这么做的吧！？

果然，曹萍有些羞臊的说：“不瞒你说，就是王强让我勾引你的。”

“卧槽！这小子有绿帽癖？”饶是李大壮早有心理准备，也还是震惊了一下：“他干啥的？不会是龟公吧？这么能忍！”

Page (1/3)

"How do you want to compensate me?" Li Dazhuang asked knowingly.

Seeing that he didn't refuse on the spot, Cao Ping felt that it was a show, and her body was trembling with excitement. The two plump and towering seats in front of her touched Li Dazhuang's strong chest muscles.

The collision between soft and hard is the easiest way to create sparks of passion, and the atmosphere between the two becomes even more ambiguous...

"Miracle Doctor Li~ Why are you deliberately teasing me~ Everyone is like this, of course it's meat..." Cao Ping paused, moved her red lips slightly, put it next to Li Dazhuang's ear, blew the fragrance and said the last word: "compensation~~"

Li Dazhuang did not refuse, nor took the initiative, and allowed Cao Ping to cause chaos in him!

The more he behaved like this, the more anxious Cao Ping became. Her weak and boneless jade hands slowly moved downwards, but her red lips pressed against Li Dazhuang's lips!

Li Dazhuang naturally would not push her away, but would take advantage of the situation and taste it...

Even though it was just a verbal spat, Cao Ping was completely conquered!

What is a real man?

Doctor Li is a real man!

It's so fierce, even the verbal battle can be so fierce!

When I was with Wang Qiang before, there was no passion at all, but now it's so exciting!

Li Dazhuang was not polite to her, and while he was arguing with her, his hands were not idle either, causing waves of ripples!

Moreover, Cao Ping's body is as soft as it looks, and Li Dazhuang's hook makes him look angry!

Cao Ping also felt Li Dazhuang's surging enthusiasm, so she continued to attack the city and even wanted to hit the sore spot!

But Li Dazhuang grabbed his wrist!

"Miracle Doctor Li~ Why are you stopping me?" Cao Ping asked in a coquettish tone.

"You have a husband. If you do this, aren't you afraid that Wang Qiang will punish you if he finds out?"

Although Li Dazhuang was very angry, he was also really curious. Although Cao Ping was very flirtatious at the moment, he could see that this woman was still very conservative at heart. She had been married to a semi-waste guy like Wang Qiang for many years and had never had an affair. She was definitely a good woman!

Then why did she suddenly become wild with him now?

Li Dazhuang suddenly thought that before forcing the king to leave, he took Cao Ping and muttered for a long time. He couldn't have asked Cao Ping to do this!?

Sure enough, Cao Ping said a little shyly: "To tell you the truth, it was Wang Qiang who asked me to seduce you."

"Holy shit! This kid has cuckold fetish?" Even though Li Dazhuang was mentally prepared, he was still shocked: "What does he do? He can't be a turtle, right? He can tolerate it so well!"
